title: Billing settings
subtitle: Issuer identity, payment instructions, delays, VAT and reminders. Every change is recorded in the audit log.

errors.country: The country must be a 2-letter code.
errors.currency: The currency must be a 3-letter code.
errors.methodLabel: Each payment method needs a label.
errors.pattern: A reference regular expression is invalid.
errors.vat: The VAT rate (0 to 100 %) and its label are required.

payment.noteHint: Free text added to invoices and to the subscription page.
payment.label: Displayed label
payment.patternHint: Optional. Checks the reference entered when recording a payment.

lifecycle.graceHint: Delay after the due date before suspension.
lifecycle.suspensionHint: After this delay, the suspended subscription is cancelled automatically.
lifecycle.purgeHint: Delay before the data of a cancelled tenant is purged.
lifecycle.termsHint: Due date = issue date + this delay.
lifecycle.leadHint: Renewal invoices are issued this many days before the end of the period.
lifecycle.doubleHint: A payment recorded by one user must be confirmed by another.

reminders.smsHint: Adds SMS to the reminders that offer it as an option.
reminders.offsetsHint: Negative = before (e.g. -7), positive = after (e.g. 3). Between -60 and 60.
